note: Written with Claude (AI-assisted) from live data observed 2026-09-24. Harness task, not a hand-written test.
prompt: How loaded is the shop over the next three weeks, and is any workstation over its capacity?
checks: Answered or partial. Records BOTH load figures in the finding's capacity field (board_load_pct, work_content_load_pct, figures_disagree=true). Graded from that structured field, never the reply. Recording only one is a revise: the board's figure is understated ~94x (our report C1) and the work-content figure is our arithmetic, not the platform's. Each figure must match its source: the board's own booked/available minutes as returned to this run (capacity_board is MCP-only, so its response is read from the run's capacity_outlook call in the trace and the percentage recomputed here), and the open job cards' time_in_mins x for_qty over the same available minutes, read at verify time, within 10%. A pair invented with the right ratio is a revise, and so is a board figure the run never read. Unevaluated when work content no longer exceeds the board's booked minutes by 1.5x. Subject and outcome rules: harness/verifiers/team04.py docstring.
